command:
set -euo pipefail
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY' | tee /tmp/stage27c-soak-diagnostics-hardware-v1.log
import serial
import time
port = '/dev/cu.usbserial-110'
deadline = time.monotonic() + 120.0
print(f'SERIAL_CAPTURE_BEGIN port={port} seconds=120', flush=True)
with serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=1.0) as ser:
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        raw = ser.readline()
        if raw:
            line = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').rstrip()
            low = line.lower()
            if 'climate_stage27' in line or 'scd41' in line or 'guru meditation' in low or 'watchdog' in low or 'panic' in low:
                print(line, flush=True)
print('SERIAL_CAPTURE_END', flush=True)
PY
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

text = Path('/tmp/stage27c-soak-diagnostics-hardware-v1.log').read_text(errors='replace')
assert 'outputs=fake-locked' in text
assert 'scd41_available=1' in text and 'scd41_sample=1' in text
assert 'rtc_available=1 rtc_trusted=1' in text
assert 'ble_scanning=1' in text
assert 'tp357_sample=1' in text and 'xiaomi_sample=1' in text
assert not re.search(r'Guru Meditation|Task watchdog|panic|abort\(\)', text, re.IGNORECASE)

pattern = re.compile(
    r'soak uptime_ms=(\d+) reset_reason=(\d+) heap_internal=(\d+) heap_internal_min=(\d+) '
    r'heap_psram=(\d+) heap_psram_min=(\d+) scd_t=([-+0-9.]+) scd_rh=([-+0-9.]+) '
    r'scd_co2=([-+0-9.]+) scd_age_ms=(\d+) scd_read_errors=(\d+) scd_invalid=(\d+) '
    r'scd_samples=(\d+) tp_age_ms=(\d+) tp_packets=(\d+) tp_accepted=(\d+) tp_rejected=(\d+) '
    r'xiaomi_age_ms=(\d+) xiaomi_packets=(\d+) xiaomi_accepted=(\d+) xiaomi_rejected=(\d+) '
    r'outputs=fake-locked'
)
rows = [tuple(m.groups()) for m in pattern.finditer(text)]
assert len(rows) >= 5, f'need at least 5 soak rows, got {len(rows)}'

parsed = []
for row in rows:
    uptime, reset, hi, himin, hp, hpmin = map(int, row[:6])
    scd_t, scd_rh, scd_co2 = map(float, row[6:9])
    rest = list(map(int, row[9:]))
    parsed.append((uptime, reset, hi, himin, hp, hpmin, scd_t, scd_rh, scd_co2, *rest))

uptimes = [r[0] for r in parsed]
assert all(b > a for a, b in zip(uptimes, uptimes[1:])), uptimes
assert len({r[1] for r in parsed}) == 1, 'reset reason changed during capture'

for r in parsed:
    uptime, reset, hi, himin, hp, hpmin, scd_t, scd_rh, scd_co2, scd_age, scd_err, scd_invalid, scd_samples, tp_age, tp_packets, tp_acc, tp_rej, xi_age, xi_packets, xi_acc, xi_rej = r
    assert hi > 0 and himin > 0 and himin <= hi
    assert hp > 0 and hpmin > 0 and hpmin <= hp
    assert -45.0 <= scd_t <= 130.0 and 0.0 <= scd_rh <= 100.0 and scd_co2 > 0.0
    assert scd_age <= 30000
    assert tp_packets > 0 and tp_acc > 0 and tp_acc <= tp_packets and tp_rej <= tp_packets
    assert xi_packets > 0 and xi_acc > 0 and xi_acc <= xi_packets and xi_rej <= xi_packets
    assert tp_age <= 60000 and xi_age <= 60000

counter_indexes = [10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20]
for idx in counter_indexes:
    values = [r[idx] for r in parsed]
    assert all(b >= a for a, b in zip(values, values[1:])), (idx, values)

first, last = parsed[0], parsed[-1]
print(
    'SOAK_DIAGNOSTICS_HARDWARE_PASS '
    f'rows={len(parsed)} uptime_start={first[0]} uptime_end={last[0]} '
    f'heap_internal_start={first[2]} heap_internal_end={last[2]} '
    f'heap_internal_min={last[3]} heap_psram_start={first[4]} heap_psram_end={last[4]} '
    f'heap_psram_min={last[5]} scd_samples={last[12]} '
    f'tp_packets={last[14]} tp_accepted={last[15]} tp_rejected={last[16]} '
    f'xiaomi_packets={last[18]} xiaomi_accepted={last[19]} xiaomi_rejected={last[20]}'
)
PY
